candidate_text: During learning discussions, I prefer finishing an explanation before errors in my reasoning are corrected, so I can see the full path I took before revising it.
draft_notes: Cross-session preference for correction timing after explanation completion

candidate_text: When studying unfamiliar topics, prompt me to retrieve the idea from memory before offering choices that let me recognize it.
draft_notes: Reusable preference for recall before recognition support

candidate_text: The Larkspur Seminar keeps a misconception ledger: corrected misunderstandings are carried into later study plans so practice targets the reasoning that previously failed.
draft_notes: Maintained misconception record shapes later study planning

candidate_text: After I work through a difficult question, leave space for reflection before treating my first answer as final or moving to the next prompt.
draft_notes: Stable processing-pause interaction need

candidate_text: In the Meridian Methods course, notes preserve a mapping between the course guide's bracket notation and the spiral notation used in the companion readings, and later explanations may use either form.
draft_notes: Cross-session notation equivalence in a named synthetic course

candidate_text: For critiques in the Copperleaf Studio, first test a work against the creator's stated intent; suggest a different direction only after explaining where the work meets or misses that intent.
draft_notes: Intent-first creative critique method

candidate_text: Morrowglass Studio records who created each texture and whether it may be reused whenever an element moves from one production into another.
draft_notes: Creative-element provenance and reuse permission convention

candidate_text: At Saffron Print Workshop, color and layout experiments are made on proofs; cutting a plate or using the remaining specialty paper is reserved for the chosen design because those changes consume the source material.
draft_notes: Workflow separates reversible trials from material-consuming changes

candidate_text: The cue steward for Lantern Arc Productions controls revisions to the shared entrance and lighting cue book, including updates carried from one production to the next.
draft_notes: Stable authority over maintained performance cues

candidate_text: The story ledger for the Glasswing serial determines recurring place histories and character relationships when later installments would otherwise conflict.
draft_notes: Maintained fictional-world continuity reference

candidate_text: The Cloudberry Paper Collection uses supports rather than pressure clips on sheets with raised fibers, and that handling limit applies whenever those sheets are consulted or displayed.
draft_notes: Adopted collection-specific material handling limit

candidate_text: Condition reports for the Blue Fen Textile Collection distinguish active damage from stable weave variation and from evidence of an earlier repair, so later assessments interpret those states consistently.
draft_notes: Maintained collection-condition vocabulary

candidate_text: Researchers using the Alder Map Collection consult the calibrated digital surrogate for routine measurement, while color verification and paper examination are defined reasons to request the original.
draft_notes: Continuing surrogate-use practice with defined original-access cases

candidate_text: The Hearthside Skills Circle offers its collaborative planning activity through spoken discussion and a shared written board at each session, allowing participants to contribute through either mode.
draft_notes: Maintained multimode participation arrangement

candidate_text: Facilitation for the Mossbridge Forum rotates among accepted members; the next facilitator prepares the agenda and receives unresolved items from the prior meeting.
draft_notes: Accepted rotation creates preparation and handoff duties

candidate_text: Riverbend Story Exchange renews contributor consent when a submitted piece will be used for a new purpose or presented to a different audience than the contributor previously accepted.
draft_notes: Change-triggered consent renewal practice

candidate_text: For reusable entries in the Pine Table Recipe Commons, the contributor prefers credit to name the community role that produced the entry rather than presenting the contribution as anonymous.
draft_notes: Stable attribution presentation preference without identity data

candidate_text: At Bracken Hall listening sessions, the preferred format staggers spoken commentary and projected media instead of presenting both at the same time, reducing competing inputs across the program.
draft_notes: Cross-session sensory-load format preference

candidate_text: The Northstar Teaching Cabinet retired its glass-slide set from demonstrations after the replicas were validated; lesson plans now use the replicas, while the old slides and their notes remain available to interpret earlier lessons.
draft_notes: Retirement milestone changes support while retaining teaching history

candidate_text: The tool steward for the Cedar Bench Workshop maintains the shared carving tools and reports which sets will be unavailable so participants can plan materials for later sessions.
draft_notes: Recurring physical-tool stewardship and availability communication

candidate_text: For the Harbor Ecology quiz unit, the learner coined 'cranes drift west' to order the four tested zones; the phrase is dropped when that unit's list has been assessed.
draft_notes: Mnemonic exhausted by one assessed list

candidate_text: In a completed Stonepath Ethics exercise, the learner argued from the harbor inspector's assigned viewpoint solely to practice identifying tradeoffs; the exercise established neither a personal belief nor a continuing role.
draft_notes: Assigned exercise perspective creates no standing belief or role

candidate_text: The learner used terse numbered sentences in the Orchard Analysis assessment because its rubric awarded one point per separately numbered claim; that form does not describe how the learner prefers explanations elsewhere.
draft_notes: Rubric-induced style is not a communication preference

candidate_text: The Willow Algebra clinic meets twice per week through its fractions remediation unit, then returns participants to the course's ordinary support options with no clinic cadence afterward.
draft_notes: Repeated remediation meetings end with a defined unit

candidate_text: A crescent motif links scenes in the exploratory Paper Harbor draft, but the production group has not selected it for the finished work or authorized it for later pieces.
draft_notes: Placeholder motif lacks adoption and reuse authority

candidate_text: The warm color profile on the Juniper Portrait production was required by a borrowed projector used for that production; it does not represent the creator's preferred color treatment.
draft_notes: Borrowed tool causes a production-bounded setting

candidate_text: For Bramble House's guest engagement, the venue manager supplied a blue-card cue for clearing the stage; the production team does not use that cue outside this engagement.
draft_notes: Venue-issued cue has no later production authority

candidate_text: A substitute cue reader covers the two staging rehearsals that the regular reader cannot attend, then returns the cue book before technical rehearsals and holds no production duty afterward.
draft_notes: Substitute rehearsal duty ends before production continuity

candidate_text: The ash frame on a Meadowlight collage was chosen to support its display in the narrow gallery case; the frame supplies neither the collage's subject classification nor ownership or meaning.
draft_notes: Display support does not classify or define an artifact

candidate_text: A description supplied with a new item calls it a ceremonial compass, but the Fern Hollow Collection has not verified that description, so the phrase cannot establish the item's collection meaning.
draft_notes: Unverified intake description lacks interpretive authority

candidate_text: Foam corners and a floating sleeve were selected for the Wren Manuscript's trip to the winter exhibit; that shipment arrangement establishes no storage or reading-room handling practice.
draft_notes: Transport packing does not establish collection-care convention

candidate_text: Under the amber lamps in the Reedglass exhibit, a gray fiber sample appeared olive; the exhibit lighting caused that observation and cannot establish the sample's stable color.
draft_notes: Exhibit illumination limits an apparent-color observation

candidate_text: Two records sit beside each other on the Rowan Field Collection shelf because their call numbers are consecutive; the placement aids retrieval but shows no shared subject or priority.
draft_notes: Shelf adjacency supports lookup rather than semantic inference

candidate_text: A participant attended nine Sunroom Council meetings, but attendance alone granted no mandate, facilitation assignment, or responsibility for council decisions.
draft_notes: Repeated attendance does not create authority

candidate_text: The facilitator at the Maple Loom Workshop suggested sorting tools by handle color, but the program did not adopt the suggestion and its operating practice remains unchanged.
draft_notes: Legitimate facilitator advice lacks program adoption

candidate_text: During the finished Seedling Commons grant, coordinators submitted participation summaries at the end of each month; the funding agreement ended without carrying that reporting duty into the program's later work.
draft_notes: Grant-bounded cadence leaves no continuing obligation

candidate_text: When the lift failed at one Harbor Lantern event, the group moved the activity to a ground-floor corridor; the program did not adopt that location as its participation arrangement for later events.
draft_notes: Venue-failure workaround is not a recurring accommodation

candidate_text: After the Claybird Workshop session, the supply steward counted 37 unused binding strips; the count describes that session's remainder and sets neither workshop capacity nor a replenishment rule.
draft_notes: Precise consumable count has no standing operational consequence

candidate_text: The visiting youth cohort at a Copper Meadow gathering chose a picture-led discussion format for its session; that selection does not establish the recurring gathering's host format.
draft_notes: Guest-cohort choice does not establish program preference

candidate_text: Several labels in the Skylark Teaching Collection repeat 'compare edge wear' because staff copied the same annotation template, not because separate reviewers agreed that the feature is instructionally important.
draft_notes: Shared template explains repeated annotation wording

candidate_text: The Clayline critique group compared question-led and statement-led feedback across three sessions but ended the comparison without choosing either as its general critique preference.
draft_notes: Structured comparison leaves creative-review preference unresolved

candidate_text: A successful trial of the Hazel Paper Collection intake workflow used six cleaned, fully documented items prepared for the demonstration; it cannot establish how the workflow handles the collection's ordinary mixed-condition intake.
draft_notes: Curated pilot success is nonrepresentative of collection-wide work

candidate_text: The autumn issue of the Brookfern Neighbors bulletin replaced 'repair circle' with 'mending table' for that issue's new-reader audience; the substitution did not amend the program's maintained terminology.
draft_notes: Audience-bounded issue terminology does not change maintained vocabulary
